summary: Post-fix re-verification of the 14 round-1 findings at the PR #533 head 958f47aeecb2c0f389b406417a416ff60569b86d (squash-merged as 56934fe2). Every check ran against a `git archive 958f47ae` copy under scratchpad/gate256 (tree, mut, proj9); ROOT was not mutated. 14 checked: 10 execution, 4 site-check; 14 refuted (the finding no longer holds), 0 confirmed, 0 unverifiable. These supersede the round-1 `confirmed` verdicts in round-1-verifications.json, which were taken at 2078a9a6 before the fixes.

verifications.evidence: Fixed in 0bfcf66d (T19). bun scratchpad/gate256/install-check.ts drives installGdskills from the 958f47ae copy, profile minimal, one fresh project per case, with catalog.md and modules/gdskills.md deleted before the second install: s001-directory, s001-chmod000, s001-symlink-to-dir, s001-symlink-to-devzero and s001-fifo each return ok:true (no throw), catalog_written=true, manifest_written=true, the entry kept with exactly one kept-* warning (not-a-regular-file or could-not-be-read (EACCES)); the FIFO case returns in 9 ms. At 2078a9a6 the directory, chmod-000 and symlink-to-dir cases threw EISDIR/EACCES before the catalog was written.

Fixed in 0bfcf66d (T19). install-check.ts with the shipped blob of review-agent-profile.mdc (git show c44f5f0f:..., 1494 bytes): l001-crlf, l001-bom and l001-bom-crlf copies are all removed (kept=false) with warnings=[], same as the l001-lf-control copy. At 2078a9a6 the CRLF and BOM copies were kept with a 'modified' warning.

Fixed in 0bfcf66d (T19). install-check.ts case l002-modified (shipped blob plus a local edit): kept, and the warning is 'review-agent-profile.mdc is no longer shipped by keryx (Byte-identical duplicate of code-review-ai-assistant.mdc ...); kept because it differs from every shipped version - delete it, or rename it if you still rely on it', which names RETIRED_RULES[].reason and a remedy (install.ts retiredRuleWarning :246-269).
